items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the interviewer mentions 'Jack London' as a location reference ('the one down on Jack London'), not as a person the interviewee knows.

ctx.x: It sure will! I agree with that.

Now I was fortunate enough to see your big band when you brought it to Yoshi’s; the old Yoshi’s, not the one down on Jack London, not the one in San Francisco, but the one that used to have the Mt. Fuji in the back, remember the beautiful Japanese-
Oh yeah, was that in San Francisco?
